verdict: Organic presence is holding; overdue deliverables are the priority this week.
narrative: Across all three locations — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — paid channels carried no spend or leads this period, so every customer interaction came through Google Business Profile and organic search. Combined, your three profiles drove 424 GBP actions in the last 28 days, including 22 calls, 277 direction requests, and 125 web clicks. Forte Metals showed real momentum with GBP actions up 50% week-over-week, while Advance Grinding and O'Hare Precision saw declines of 33% and 57% respectively in the most recent week — a trend we are actively investigating for visibility and indexing issues. Several project milestones tied to CRM setup, web and SEO fixes, and outreach contact pulls were due by August 31 and are being resolved as the immediate focus heading into September.

highlights.phrase: total Google Business Profile actions across all three locations in the last 28 days
inbound calls generated from your profiles this period, with no paid spend behind them
organic search clicks to O'Hare Precision alone over the last 28 days

watch_item.issue: GBP actions dropped sharply at Advance Grinding and O'Hare Precision in the last 7 days, with both profiles showing zero actions on August 29–31 — pointing to a search visibility or indexing issue, not a demand shift.
watch_item.fix: A web and SEO root-cause fix is being submitted now, and profile health across all three locations is being reviewed to restore visibility before the trend extends into September.
